findings.rule: The property manager sees compliance reports of completed rounds but not individual readings.
findings.evidence: A chief created a future shift with no rounds at all; a chief shiftRounds control returned []. POST /q/shiftsList as each manager returned HTTP 200 with the new shift id, full label, startsAt and endsAt, along with the building-wide shift schedule. This exposes shift metadata unrelated to any completed round. The repaired compliance query itself correctly excludes uncompleted rounds.
